catalogs.completeness_basis: Catalog A-Z Index of the 2026-2027 catalog. The 120 bachelor-labelled entries were collapsed to 49 major+award programs. Excluded: concentrations, 3+2/joint/integrated bachelor's+master's plans, and 'Second Bachelors'. Majors listed only through concentrations count once (e.g. Biology BS, Chemistry BS, Health Sciences BS). Counted anyway because unsure: 4 double-major entries, including Biology/Chemistry and Chemistry/Biology as 2 because records key them that way. The 38 verified records cover 38 of the 49.

catalogs.completeness_basis: CU Denver Undergraduate Programs A-Z of the 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, counted as 86 programs: one per listed bachelor's entry, as records are keyed. Rural-partnership variants collapse to one program, and tracks, options and emphases collapse to their major: BFA emphases become Visual Arts BFA and Film & Television BFA, and the Music BS emphases become Music BS. Separately listed licensure-endorsement and Gardner Scholar entries count separately. Excluded: minors, certificates, microcredentials, 4+1/BA-MA/5-year combined entries and licensure pathways. Counted anyway because unsure: 2 Economics dual bachelor's degrees, and Information & Cybersecurity Management BSBA, which appears only in the page navigation. The 77 verified records cover 75 of the 86: 2 records are both Science (6-12) License BA, and Nursing BS (an Anschutz program) is not on this list.
